wiki.title: Anne Charnock (politician)
wiki.extract: Anne B. Charnock is an American politician serving as a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate for the 17th district. In February 2025, she was appointed by governor Patrick Morrisey to fill the vacancy left by Eric Nelson. She is an attorney who formerly served as a judge on the Municipal Court of Charleston for 12 years. She attended George Washington High School in Charleston, West Virginia, and graduated from West Virginia University with both a Bachelor of Arts and a Juris Doctor.
